articles.title: US lawmakers warn against presidential pardon for Sam Bankman-Fried
articles.snippet: The former FTX CEO is currently serving a 25-year sentence after being found guilty on seven felony charges related to the misuse of customer funds.

articles.title: Bitcoin price sets $64.5K week-to-date low as Strategy selling worries return
articles.snippet: Bitcoin circled $65,000 after downside BTC price pressure into the FOMC meeting as analysis warned over the impact of Strategy potentially selling more BTC in the future.

articles.title: Bitcoin trader warns of 'bearish reaction' to FOMC with $64K now essential
articles.snippet: Bitcoin approached important near-term support on new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first FOMC day with a $55,000 BTC price target still on the table.

articles.title: XRP whale wallet withdrawals top 720M as risk-adjusted return data points to opportunity
articles.snippet: Whales pulled more than 720 million XRP from exchanges, as various data points converge to predict a potential 50% rally.

articles.title: BlackRock Debuts BITA Bitcoin ETF, Trading Partial Upside for Double-Digit Yield
articles.snippet: BlackRock launched an ETF that limits Bitcoin gains in exchange for double-digit payouts by selling call options on its holdings.
